title: Catalog Lookup API & Dispatcher Actions
deliverables: 6 dispatcher actions wired in calcDispatcher: tool_catalog_search, tool_catalog_lookup, tool_catalog_assembly, tool_catalog_collision_envelope, tool_catalog_recommend, tool_catalog_stats
search(): filter by type, diameter, iso_group, manufacturer, operation, coating, flute_count
recommend(): scored results with grade suitability, diameter match, depth coverage, manufacturer bonuses
assembly() + collisionEnvelope(): full tool+holder assembly with collision profile
